title: A valid missing completion must continue the same unfinished action without replay

Valid recorded Improve passes are submitted without rerecording. Fresh driver sessions first recover the existing packet once; real callback validation alone advances. Preserve paused/blocked states, ownership, corrupt-state fail-open, timeout/failure exits and existing user limits. No automatic callback or restart.
